workflows.title: Coverage change audit
workflows.decision: Distinguish newly exercised behavior from changes to coverage definitions, options and denominator.
intent_questions: Which intended behavior, expression and sampling/mode conditions define the original coverage obligation?
Does the reported change represent additional exercise, changed acceptance thresholds or a changed required population, and what source justifies each exclusion?

evidence_roles.meaning: Original independently required behavior, objective or acceptance contract
Actual selected revision, configuration, mode and native tool/model basis
Original native observations and outcomes for the selected engineering question
Source-backed logical-to-native entity and population relationships

revalidate_when: Original requirement, applicability, exclusion rationale or receiving decision changes
Selected native entity, source, configuration, mode, tool/model version or extraction method changes
A dependent relationship or observation premise is changed, missing or contradicted

workflows.title: Fault coverage denominator review
workflows.decision: Review fault coverage denominator review through existing correction, handoff and revalidation.
intent_questions: Which original fault objective, native model/population and metric definition govern closure?
Which actual detections differ from classification, collapse or exclusion changes, and which source justifies each current exclusion?
